problem:
A body of mass $\sqrt{2}\,\text{kg}$ is moving in a straight line along the $x$-axis under the action of a single force $F,$ measured in Newtons $(\text{N}).$  At time $t$ seconds, the velocity of the body is given by $v(t)=\operatorname{sec}⁡t$ meters per second. 

Calculate the magnitude of the force at time $t=\frac{\pi }{4}$ seconds. Do not round the answer.

The magnitude of the force equals
{{field-1}} $\text{N}.$
